messages:
Mira: dropping an updated compact timeline mock for the rollout panel — tries a condensed left rail with mini-scrub + allocation slider inline. mock: https://img.redwood.test/mocks/compact-tl-v2.png
Samir: love the tighter density. question: when you hover a snapshot the slider currently jumps to 50% — that's accidental. Can we decouple hover preview from allocation control?
Tess: copy nit on the rollback action: current button text is 'Rollback to snapshot' which reads like a verb+target duplicate. Recommend 'Restore snapshot' (shorter) and confirmation header 'Restore snapshot to active traffic' to make intent explicit.
Mira: agree on shorter CTA. Also thinking about adding a small delta badge ("+2% latency") next to each snapshot to indicate perf regression. Would that be noisy?
Samir: good use. make delta badge optional in settings (default off). Important: badges must have accessible text so screen readers get "latency increased 2 percent".
Tess: mobile layout: slider becomes a full-width control below the snapshot list. But on smaller screens we lose the scrub affordance. Could replace scrub with prev/next chevrons and a swipe region.
Mira: accessibility check: ops-bot, run contrast + keyboard tests on the new palette and tab flow?
ops-bot: keyboard smoke results: tab order goes slider -> scrub -> snapshot -> action. Expected: scrub -> snapshot -> slider -> action. Also focus ring hidden for certain buttons. See /reports/1743210000/keyboard.json
contrast-bot: color scan: warning — thumb color on the slider fails 4.5:1 against background in dark theme. Delta badge green (#28a745) passes but the white text on green fails in small sizes. Link: https://contrast.redwood/reports/1743210000
Samir: for keyboard flow we should make the scrub a single interactive element with left/right arrow handling and then have each snapshot as a focusable card — that keeps order consistent. Also add aria-valuetext on slider: "Canary allocation: 10 percent".
Tess: confirmation modal UX: propose two-step confirm for full restores >50% traffic: 1) 'Are you sure?', 2) type the snapshot id to confirm. For <=50% just a single confirm button. Thoughts?
Mira: I'm uneasy about extra friction for >50% restores during incidents. Might be safer to have a single confirm but an obvious secondary action "Require typed confirmation" toggle in workspace settings for stricter orgs.
Samir: devs: also surface the commit hash on hover/focus and include a copy icon (aria-label="Copy commit hash"). Avoid relying on color alone for the regression badge 12; add an icon (up/down caret).
Tess: acceptance criteria for handoff: 1) CTA reads 'Restore snapshot' and confirmation header matches; 2) keyboard order matches visual order; 3) slider has aria-valuetext and visible 3px focus ring; 4) delta badges include icon + alt text; 5) mobile swaps scrub for chevrons + swipe.
Mira: great. I'll update the Figma with those and toggle the delta badges default off. I'll also attach updated microcopy strings in the ticket. pinging @product for signoff when done. :wave:
